name: sealed-v0.4
note: Wider than the visible training randomization and with plant mechanisms the visible plant lacks; 15 blind 31-bit perturbation seeds (7 cases x 15 seeds = 105 scheduled episodes) unseen in development. Lives only in the verifier image / private evaluation mount. Data-grounded values: FAIR-MAST double-null flat-tops (environment/data/fair_mast/derived_ranges.json, CC BY-SA 4.0, UKAEA), 5-95% ranges and p75 sensor residuals, mapped through environment/data/fair_mast/profile_calibration.json; drifts span the within-shot interquartile range over one 0.35 s episode. Supply, flux-loop drift, passive-filament and profile-constraint values match the frozen v0.3/v0.4 physics specification.
